config.title: OpenCode TUI für VS Code
cfg.opencodePath.desc: Pfad zu opencode. Z.B. 'C:/Users/ilgiz/AppData/Local/OpenCode/opencode.exe', 'opencode.cmd' oder einfach 'opencode'.
cfg.serverPort.desc: Port für den opencode-Server. 0 = zufälliger freier Port.
cfg.serverMode.desc: Server mode: 'embedded' (default) runs the TUI with its own private server; 'separate' runs a headless 'opencode serve' plus an attached TUI; 'external' attaches to a server you launched yourself (extra memory).
cfg.serverAddress.desc: Address of an externally launched 'opencode serve', e.g. http://127.0.0.1:4096. Used only in 'external' mode. Stored in settings, reused across sessions.
cfg.serverPassword.desc: Password of the external server (OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD). Empty = the server needs no password.
cmd.toggleFocus.title: OpenCode-Fokus umschalten
cfg.leaderChords.desc: Leader-Chord-Zeichen zum Abfangen (z.B. ["n","m","l"]). Leer = tui.json oder integrierte Standardeinstellungen verwenden.
cfg.ctrlASelectAll.desc: Ctrl+A leitet zur Auswahl aller im Eingabefeld um, anstatt den Cursor-an-den-Anfang an das Terminal zu senden.
cfg.enterSendsMessage.desc: Press Enter to send, Shift+Enter for new line
cfg.orphanCleanup.startupScan.desc: Scan for and clean up orphan opencode processes on startup
cfg.orphanCleanup.watchdog.desc: Enable watchdog to clean up orphan opencode processes after VS Code closes
